caption: The drawing depicts a segment of a carved stone architectural detail, showing a rectangular panel with intricate symmetrical patterns. The main panel is colored in various shades of green and displays a series of repeating, stylized organic motifs resembling ferns or fronds with curved, leaf-like extensions, organized along a central vertical axis. The panel is bordered by thicker beige or light tan stone blocks, which exhibit a rough, weathered texture and circular or rounded indentations along their edges. The background of the image is a flat off-white or light cream color. In the lower right corner, there are three color swatches in green, beige, and grey, possibly to indicate the primary colors used in the illustration.
title: Keystone in Arch at San Juan Capistrano Mission
